name: Lovers Collection
original_name: ラヴァーズ・コレクション
source:
The protagonist worked for "Licht Craft", a ladies' apparel shop as a fashion advisor. One day however, she was suddenly transferred to the mens' brand shop "La Climat" due to staff shortages.

"La Climat" is ran by store manager Satoru, the protagonist's senior colleague of 2 years. Since Satoru was also her childhood friend, she felt at ease for the time being. That said, "La Climat" operated differently from what she was used to, after having worked at a ladies' brand for 8 months. There were so many things to remember, which caused her to get flustered and make mistakes.

Despite her circumstances, her natural cheerfulness and passion towards the job were assets that helped her to gradually attract more customers.
A fastidious salaryman and father who works at a top-class trading company...
An in-demand host popular at the host club he works for...
An aspiring actor getting by on part-time jobs...
A mysterious and elusive man...
And the store manager of a rival shop...

As their personalities and preferences were all different, coordinating an outfit for each of them was a struggle. After having met and getting to know them though, that struggle even felt like part of the fun of her job.

Her cheerfulness and drive captivates one of the guys, and...

[Translation of official website story summary.]
translation:
主人公原本在女装店“Licht Craft”担任时尚顾问。然而有一天，由于人手不足，她突然被调到男装品牌店“La Climat”。

“La Climat”的店长悟是主人公早她两年入职的前辈，同时也是她的青梅竹马，因此她暂时感到十分安心。不过，她此前在女装品牌工作了8个月，而“La Climat”的经营方式与她熟悉的完全不同。需要记住的事情实在太多，让她手忙脚乱、频频犯错。

尽管处境不易，她天生的开朗性格与对工作的热情依然成为优势，帮助她逐渐吸引了更多顾客。
在顶级贸易公司任职、十分讲究的工薪族父亲…
在牛郎俱乐部里广受欢迎的当红牛郎…
靠兼职维持生活、立志成为演员的青年…
神秘而令人捉摸不透的男子…
以及竞争店铺的店长…

他们的个性与喜好各不相同，为每个人搭配服装都令人煞费苦心。然而在相遇并逐渐了解彼此之后，这份辛苦似乎也成了工作的乐趣之一。

她的开朗与干劲打动了其中一名男子，而…

[翻译自官方网站的故事简介。]
